2 خمّسهُ , inf. n. تَخْمِيسٌ, He made it five. (EshSheybánee and K, voce وَحَّدَهُ.) ―
-b2- He made it to be five-cornered; five-angled; pentagonal. (K.) ―
-b3- خَمَّسَتْ She brought forth her fifth offspring. (TA in art. بكر.) ―
-b4- And خمّسهُ He made it five-fifths. (Msb.) ―
-b5- خمّس لِٱمْرَأَتِهِ, or عِنْدَهَا, He remained five nights with his wife: and in like manner the verb is used in relation to any saying or action. (TA voce سَبَّعَ.) ―
-b6- تَخْمِيسٌ also signifies [The watering of land or seedproduce on the fifth day, counting the day of the next preceding watering as the first;] the watering of land that is [next] after the تَرْبِيع. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
